authority_boundary: Asset recognition scores are deterministic candidate signals. They do not prove value, truth, safety, licensing, or authority, and they do not authorize copying private contents across repos.

candidate_locations.reason: Repo entrypoints often encode local non-negotiables, workflow memory, and navigational structure.
Registries and schemas usually carry reusable contracts, vocabularies, and source-of-truth boundaries.
Templates and prompts can become reusable workflow assets when provenance and context are preserved.
Harnesses and evals are high-leverage because they improve future coding, review, and validation loops.
Governance, data movement, and architecture maps help repos decide what can safely move or change.

recognition_signals.description: Path or task mentions source truth, authority, governance, canonical registries, or design authority.
Path or task mentions agent, skill, preflight, midflight, postflight, prompt, or review workflows.
Path or task mentions tests, evals, parity, benchmark, performance, or validation.
Machine-readable JSON/YAML/TOML files can be reusable contracts when reviewed.
Markdown docs can be reusable assets when they encode workflows, decisions, or templates.

downgrade_signals.reason: Generated cache and build output should not become reusable assets.
Secret-like paths are excluded from asset sharing and require sensitive handling.
Archive and temp paths need extra provenance review before promotion.
README-only harness folder notes are navigation scaffolding, not implemented scripts, evals, or examples.
Explicit stubs can be useful template evidence but should not be ranked as implemented runtime or eval assets.

importance_tiers.meaning: Likely high-leverage for AI coding, testing, review, or repo governance.
importance_tiers.required_review: Human or senior-agent review before promotion to DAD offerings.

importance_tiers.meaning: Likely reusable as a DAD library asset or repo-local pointer.
importance_tiers.required_review: Check provenance, license, public/private movement, and local authority.

importance_tiers.meaning: Worth preserving as a candidate with source pointer and context.
importance_tiers.required_review: Keep as candidate metadata until a future task needs it.

scan_policy.content_policy: Default scans use path and metadata only. Do not copy file contents, private rows, secrets, credentials, or large raw blobs into candidate reports.
